## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a relevant issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results, including explicit skips or unavailable dependencies. For numerical changes, include an independent reference and error tolerance.

## Evidence and compatibility

State changes to shapes, dtypes, numerical semantics, artifact schemas, or comparison boundaries. Separate functional correctness, model timing, native simulator observations, and hardware measurements. Include third-party source and license information when adding an adapter or asset.
